text: John tells Maria in a session dated 3 June 2023 that his family recently had to say goodbye to their dog Max, who had been an important part of the family for 10 years.
Maria tells John that losing a pet is tough because pets are like family, and asks John how the family has been coping with the loss of Max.
John says the family is still sad about Max but has been comforted by the good times and memories they shared with him, and that the family will keep doing its best.
John says the family plans to make progress in the coming weeks to honour the memories of their loved ones, and shares a photo of Max, a dog sitting in the grass with a leash, which John cherishes.
Maria says Max looks peaceful in the photo John shared, just chilling in the backyard, and that remembering Max this way is a great way to honour him.
John says Max brought the family so much joy, taught them a lot about love and loyalty, and that the family will think of Max as peaceful and happy.
John says Max taught the family the importance of unconditional love and loyalty, and that John wants John's kids to learn those lessons too, as Max's bond with the family was so special.
As of 3 June 2023, John says the family is considering adopting a rescue dog, both for love and to teach John's kids responsibility and compassion.
Maria says adopting a rescue dog would give the pup a loving home and teach John's kids important values, and mentions that Maria has just started volunteering at a local dog shelter once a month.
Maria offers to help John's family if they need any help, and John thanks Maria, saying it is awesome to have friends like her and that the family will let Maria know if they need help.

Maria tells John on 12 June 2023 that she is sorry about Max, and that Maria and some friends from church went camping over the weekend of 10 June 2023, which was a blast and took Maria's mind off losing a pet.
Maria shares a photo with John of a group of men sitting around a campfire, taken on the camping trip with Maria's church friends the weekend of 10 June 2023.
John says John went on a mountaineering trip with workmates in the week of 5 June 2023 (last week), which was great and helped John clear John's head after the loss of Max.

John says the mountaineering group made it to the summit, where the view was stunning, and that the climb was tough but awesome; John shares a photo of a man standing on a mountaintop with a backpack.
Maria says that when Maria was younger, Maria's family went on a road trip to Oregon, and Maria shares a photo of a person standing on a cliff overlooking a canyon from that trip.
Maria says that hiking to the top and seeing a waterfall with a bridge over it was awesome and breathtaking, and Maria shares a photo of that waterfall with the bridge over it.
Maria says being at the waterfall felt like being in a fairy tale, with calming water sounds and beautiful surroundings, and John agrees that nature has a way of calming people down.
John describes nature as a reset button and camping as an awesome way to get away from it all, and says John has camped plenty of times and loves how uncomplicated camping is.
Maria says Maria has camped a few times but has never tried mountain climbing, which Maria thinks sounds thrilling, and asks John whether John has been camping before.

Maria says being in nature helps people take a break from life's craziness and recognise what truly matters, and John adds that it is important to appreciate the small things and find moments of peace.

Maria says Maria finds Zen through a mix of things, mainly a moment to herself plus favorite tunes, and that Maria also enjoys aerial yoga because it is a great way to switch off and focus on the body.

Maria says Maria's favorite aerial yoga poses are the upside-down poses, which make Maria feel free and light, and that aerial yoga is totally worth the challenge because of the freedom and connection it brings.

John shares a photo of a group of people standing around a playground and says the day at the park with John's family on 12 June 2023 was awesome, with the kids having lots of fun and the family having nice family time.

Maria tells John on 16 June 2023 that Maria joined a gym in the week of 5 June 2023 (last week), finds it super positive, is sticking to Maria's workout routine, and finds the people and atmosphere welcoming.
Maria says Maria wants to get stronger and improve Maria's endurance, and is trying kundalini yoga as part of Maria's fitness goals.
John says a positive environment and supportive people can really help with motivation, asks Maria about her fitness goals, and says John is trying out different workout regimes lately.
John says rock climbing sounds like a fun way to push John's limits, and asks Maria whether Maria has ever given rock climbing a go; Maria replies that Maria has not tried it yet.
Maria asks John to let Maria know how rock climbing goes if John gives it a shot, and John agrees to let Maria know.
John tells Maria on 16 June 2023 that John was promoted at work to assistant manager after a loooong time coming, and that John is over the moon about the promotion.
John says the promotion feels like a stepping stone to bigger things and that all the hard work John has put in has finally paid off, with John excited about the new role.
John shares a photo of a golden trophy on a black surface, which commemorates John's journey and is a symbol of all the obstacles John had to overcome to get to the promotion.
John says the challenges John faced included tech stuff and workplace stuff, but the worst was self-doubt, and that with support at home and John's own grit, John powered through.
John says the promotion is a reward for the hustle and hardship John put in and a reminder that John is on the right path, and Maria says John's perseverance and determination are inspiring.
John says having support and believing in himself really helped John through the challenges, and that John is really lucky to have John's family on the journey together.
John shares a photo of a desk with a chair and a lamp as John's workspace, and says John usually works during regular work hours but sometimes brings work home too.
John shares a photo of a desk with a computer, keyboard and notebook, and says John balances work and life by organising John's time and making sure John is there for the important things.
Maria says taking time for ourselves and the important people in our lives is vital, and shares a photo of a person walking on a beach with a surfboard.
John recalls a special vacation to California with a gorgeous sunset and an awesome night strolling the shore, and says taking time off for ourselves and our family is so important.
Maria shares a photo of a sunset over water from a vacation to Florida, saying the colors were amazing and that Maria felt gratitude sitting there with Maria's family.
John shares a photo of two children playing in ocean waves from John's family vacation and says enjoying special family times is why life is great.
Maria tells John on 27 June 2023 that Maria has been struggling, but is focusing on the positive and relying on Maria's friends and family for support.
John asks Maria how Maria's family has been helping, and says that support from loved ones can make a big difference when life is hard.
Maria says Maria's family has been a rock, giving Maria encouragement and reminding Maria that Maria is not alone, and that having their support is a relief.
John says his family, in the week of 19 June 2023 (last week), had a blast at a live music event, and seeing the family dancing and having fun was awesome, with the energy in the air amazing.
John says finding silver linings helps him keep going through tough times, and asks Maria how she has been finding silver linings in tough times.

Maria says volunteering at the shelter made Maria feel great to help, and that one memorable moment was when a shelter resident who had been sad for months laughed while Maria was playing with the kids.
John says a brief moment with someone can make a difference, and that playing with kids can bring such joy and happiness, and thanks Maria for sharing the shelter memory.
Maria says being able to make a difference brings Maria joy, and that volunteering at the shelter is Maria's way of spreading kindness and positivity.
John says Maria's way of passing on kindness and positivity is making a big impact on the world, and tells Maria that Maria is really making a difference and should keep it up.
Maria says John's words really mean a lot, that it is always nice to know Maria's work is making an impact, and that Maria will keep volunteering and speak to John soon.
Maria shares a photo with John on 3 July 2023 of three children sitting on a step smiling, whom Maria met at the shelter, and John asks for updates on how the children are doing.

Maria tells John that a car ran a red light and hit Maria and the group with Maria on 2 July 2023 ('yesterday' in the session), but everyone involved is okay, and Maria shares a photo of the damaged car on a flatbed.
Maria says Maria's cousin had a tough time recently, so Maria is lending a hand in helping the cousin find a new place to live.

Maria says the cousin had to leave and find a new place in a hurry, which has been really stressful, but the cousin is making progress; Maria shares a photo of a row of houses with a sidewalk and trees.
John asks whether Maria's cousin needs any specific help and offers to assist as well, and Maria asks John for any resources or organisations John knows of that could help the cousin.
John says John will look for resources or organisations that might be able to assist Maria's cousin, and will do John's best to find some and let Maria know about anything else John can do.
Maria says a safe home is key to the cousin's wellbeing, and John agrees that a safe home is essential for wellbeing and that it is great that Maria is supporting the cousin.

Maria shares a photo of many white portable homes in a parking lot and says moments like these remind Maria how much kindness and compassion matter, and that small acts of kindness make a big difference.

Maria tells John that a shelter resident named Laura wrote the volunteers a letter expressing gratitude, and that the impact the volunteers made on Laura's life was inspiring; Maria shares a photo of the handwritten letter.

John says John recently joined a marching event for veterans' rights, which was awesome and made John remember how much veterans sacrifice for us, and John shares a photo of a badge and a flag on a table.
John says John has always had great respect for the military and joined the veterans' march to show support and stand up for what John believes in, as of 3 July 2023.
John says being around others who shared the same values and passion at the veterans' march was amazing and motivated John to try to make a difference through activism.
Maria says volunteering makes Maria feel like Maria is making a difference, even if it is a small one, and John replies that even small things can mean a lot.

John tells Maria on 5 July 2023 that education and infrastructure shape communities, and that when they are lacking they can stunt growth in neighbourhoods, which drives John to do what John can to make things better.
John says feeling like it is an uphill battle is tough, but knowing there are people who see the value in education and infrastructure keeps John going.
Maria says John has a support system while tackling tough stuff, that Maria is here to lend an ear or help out however Maria can, and that John is really making a difference.

John says John sometimes doubts whether John is making a difference, but knowing people understand John's work means a lot and keeps John going; John shares a photo of John's family posing on a train track in the fall.
John says the family photo was from a trip John's family took last year, in 2022, for John's daughter Sara's birthday, and that the trip was so much fun and full of good memories.
John says John's family motivates John to keep striving for change, and that when times get hard John looks at the family photo and remembers why John is doing this work.
Maria says Maria is inspired by chatting to people, volunteering and listening to music, and asks John what else keeps John inspired.
John says John's family, exercise and spending time with friends are the things that keep John inspired and motivated as of 5 July 2023.
Maria says little things like a walk or a song can totally switch up one's outlook, and John agrees that little things like this can make a big impact on how people think.

John shares a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a sailboat in the distance, taken on John's walk in the week of 26 June 2023 (last week), which reminds John to take a break, breathe and appreciate nature.
John says John sees sunsets like that at least once a week on John's walks, and that it is a good way to disconnect, think and find peace in this crazy world.
Maria says Maria has been taking regular me-time walks at the park nearby, which has made a big impact on Maria, and that it is good that John has walks to remind John to take time to detach.
John tells Maria on 7 July 2023 that John's old area was hit by a nasty flood in the week of 26 June 2023 (last week), and that the poor infrastructure meant lots of homes were ruined.
John says the flood is reminding John that the community needs to fix things up, and that John is getting people together to chat about the issue and discuss potential solutions.
Maria offers to help John, asking whether there is anything Maria can do, and then says Maria is down to join the meeting and contribute to making the community better.
John shares a photo of a party invitation on a table with a pen and paper, related to the community meeting John is organising to discuss potential solutions for the flood-affected area.
Maria says that community change starts small and that Maria's actions, no matter how small, can have a big impact, and that Maria wants to keep spreading kindness and inspiring hope.
John says little steps count and that John and Maria can really make a difference together in the community, and John says it is awesome to have Maria by John's side in the community work.
Maria says Maria is off to have dinner with friends from the gym on 7 July 2023, and tells John to talk later.

John tells Maria on 17 July 2023 that the week of 10 July 2023 (last week) was eye-opening, because John visited a veterans' hospital and met amazing people, which made John appreciate what the community has and the need to give back.

John says John heard cool stories from an elderly veteran named Samuel during the hospital visit, which were inspiring and heartbreaking and filled John with hope, reminding John why John wanted to join the military.
John says John is part of an organisation of passionate people who are like a family and always support each other, and that it is great to be part of this organisation.

Maria says Maria had a picnic with friends from church over the weekend of 15 July 2023, where they chilled under the trees, played games and ate yummy food; Maria shares a photo of the picnic table with drinks and snacks.
Maria says the games played at the church picnic included charades and a scavenger hunt, and that everyone had a good laugh.

John says John is thinking of setting up a similar games event for John's kids soon, after seeing arts and crafts and fun activities at a community event in June 2023 (last month) that had games for families.

John shares a photo of a young girl writing at a table, and says John figured John would try the community event's activities out with John's family and friends, since everyone was having a blast there.
Maria says connecting with others and discovering fun activities is always awesome, and John says life is too short, so John and Maria should have some fun together.
Maria says Maria and John both understand the importance of making connections and enjoying life's simpler moments, and John says spreading positivity and making a difference is important.
John says little acts of kindness can really brighten someone's day, and Maria says doing good and helping others brings joy, as of 17 July 2023.

John tells Maria on 22 July 2023 that John is really enjoying John's new job, and that John's team has been super encouraging and inspiring; John shares a photo of a group of people posing for a picture.

Maria says Maria had a great experience hiking with Maria's church friends over the weekend of 15 July 2023 (last weekend), and that being surrounded by supportive people and enjoying nature felt refreshing.
Maria says Maria went on the church hike to make connections, laugh together and take in nature's beauty, and that reaching the top was amazing and the view was breathtaking.

Maria says seeing how huge the world is made Maria feel like part of something special, giving Maria a real sense of peace, and John says nature can make people feel small yet connected to something greater.
Maria says Maria plans to explore more and volunteer at shelters in August 2023 (next month), and John says John is super pumped for Maria's next adventure and for Maria putting positivity out there.
John says John goes often to a yoga studio with a chill vibe and awesome instructors, and that the studio offers a bunch of classes including yoga, kickboxing and circuit training.
John says John has done weight training so far as well, which was challenging but peaceful, kind of like yoga, and that trying new stuff is a great way to push yourself and mix things up.
Maria says yoga is a great way to relax and concentrate, that joining a new class might be a good option, and that Maria should give new classes a go as of 22 July 2023.

Maria tells John on 31 July 2023 that in the week of 24 July 2023 (last week) Maria dropped off baked goods at the homeless shelter, and that the experience left Maria more motivated than ever to help people.

John says Maria's drive to make a difference made John think about how John could help too, so John joined a fire-fighting brigade in late July 2023, which feels great as a way to give back to the community.
John says the fire brigade training was intense and taxing but really rewarding, and that it changed John's view on helping others.
John says the brigade's first call-out was on Sunday 30 July 2023 (last Sunday), an intense response in which the team worked together to help those in need, and that seeing their relief was awesome.
John shares a photo of firefighter gear laid out on the floor, and says it was chaotic when the crew arrived at the call-out, but they pulled together and saved a family from a burning building.
John says the call-out was an adrenaline rush, and that knowing the crew made a difference made it worth it; Maria says helping out like that takes guts and is inspiring.
John says the fire brigade members trust and rely on one another, have become like family to John, and that John has not felt this kind of bond since John's time in the military.
John says the brigade members have different skills and talents, but they all contribute to serving and protecting the community, and that John finds the work fulfilling and meaningful.
Maria shares a photo of a group of people standing around a table with food from a volunteering shift, saying Maria volunteered and that being kind matters, and Maria says Maria will keep it up.

John tells Maria on 3 August 2023 that John asked family and friends to join the virtual support group John belongs to and become advocates for the military, and that many people have come together to back those serving the nation.
Maria says Maria is doing Maria's part by volunteering at a homeless shelter, which is so rewarding, and Maria shares a photo of a group of people standing around a table.

Maria says Maria started volunteering at the shelter about a year before August 2023 (around August 2022), after witnessing a family struggling on the streets, and then reached out to ask whether the shelter needed volunteers.
Maria says Maria has found volunteering at the shelter fulfilling since then, and that knowing Maria can make a difference keeps Maria motivated even though it has been tough.
Maria says a shelter resident named Cindy wrote Maria a heartfelt note of gratitude that shows the impact of the support residents receive; Maria shares a photo of the note being written.

John says that in the week of 24 July 2023 (last week) John had a meaningful experience at a military memorial that made a big impact on John's kids, and John shares a photo of a young boy holding a flag in a cemetery.
John says John's kids were awestruck and humbled at the military memorial, and that showing children how to respect and appreciate those who served the country is important.
Maria says it is super important to teach kids about veterans and what they did for us, and that John is doing a great thing and the world needs more people like John.
John says teamwork can accomplish amazing things, and Maria agrees that together the two of them can get amazing stuff done and do this.
John says John seriously admires what Maria does at the homeless shelter and says Maria has made an impact that is awesome, as of 3 August 2023.
John tells Maria on 5 August 2023 that John lost his job at a mechanical engineering company after the company tanked, which has been really rough and was never seen coming.
John says John has been looking into opportunities in the tech industry for a while, and that Maria's encouragement gave John the push to consider a change after losing the job.
John says John may have found a job at a tech company that needs John's mechanical skills for its hardware team, which feels different but is a great opportunity for John to learn and contribute.
Maria says Maria took up community work with Maria's friends from church on Friday 4 August 2023 ('yesterday' in the session), and that it was super rewarding.
Maria says community work reminds Maria how important kindness and compassion are, and Maria asks John whether John has had any volunteer experiences to share.
John says John has not been able to volunteer much lately but cares about it, and that last year, in 2022, John helped renovate a rundown community center back home.
John says renovating the community center took a lot of work, but seeing the impact on the community and everyone coming together to help was so worth it, and it has been amazing to see it so busy.
John says John will keep pushing forward and doing John's best, and that Maria's words are motivating; Maria says Maria is here to support John and to help in any way Maria can.

Maria tells John on 9 August 2023 that in the week of 31 July 2023 (last week) Maria volunteered at the homeless shelter, where Maria was given a medal, which was humbling; Maria shares a photo of the medal hanging from a tree.
John says John took part in a community event to raise money for a good cause over the weekend of 5 to 6 August 2023 (last weekend), and that the event got a great turnout of supportive people.
John says John set up a 5K charity run in John's neighbourhood over the weekend of 5 to 6 August 2023 to help veterans and their families, and that the run raised some funds for the cause.
John says organising the 5K run was hard work, involving getting sponsors, coordinating with the city and spreading the word, but seeing everyone come together to support veterans made it worth it.
John says getting sponsors for the 5K run was difficult, as John reached out to several businesses through different means, but it paid off with awesome sponsors who made the event a hit.

John says John worked with a local organisation that helps victims of domestic abuse, and the 5K event raised awareness and funds for that cause, which John says is unfortunate given how many people suffer.
Maria says it is important to support the organisations fighting domestic abuse, and that John did great raising awareness and funds at the event, as of 9 August 2023.

Maria says it is an honour to know someone like John who takes initiative, and asks John how John organised the run; John shares photos from the day, including a group photo and a map of the downtown streets.
Maria says John and Maria are friends who are both passionate and motivated, and Maria says they should talk again soon; John replies that friends like Maria make a big difference.
Maria tells John on 11 August 2023 that Maria got a puppy named Coco about two weeks earlier (around 28 July 2023), and Maria shares a photo of Coco, a white dog lying in the grass.
Maria says Coco brings joy to Maria's life and is always there to greet Maria when Maria comes home, and that taking care of Coco has been an adjustment but totally worth it.
John says John is still thinking about Max, and shares a photo of Max, a dog lying on the floor next to a person, saying that pets are the best for lifting our spirits.
John says John and Max had a blast on a camping trip in the summer before (summer 2022), where they hiked, swam and made great memories together, which was a peaceful and awesome experience.
John says camping in nature, away from the noise, was chill and a nice break from the everyday hustle and bustle, and John shares a photo of a tent in the woods with a blue tarp.
John says being in nature was like restarting John's mind and spirit, and that it helped John remember the little things in life and savour the peaceful moments, as shown in a sunset bench photo.
Maria says camping with pets can be soul-nourishing and that nature is like a reset for our souls, and Maria says John's photos capture that feeling.
John says there have been tough times lately, and that as of 11 August 2023 John feels stumped, is not making much of an impact in John's current place, and is questioning John's decisions and goals.
John says John just wants to positively affect people and the world but feels stuck, and needs to find a better way to focus John's passion and enthusiasm.

John says one idea John has explored is joining local organisations or volunteering programmes, and John plans to make a list of the ones that suit what John believes in and reach out for more information.
Maria suggests John research and explore the organisations John would be interested in, and says taking small steps can help John channel energy into something meaningful and make a difference.

John tells Maria on 13 August 2023 that since their last chat John has been volunteering as a mentor for a local school, which is really rewarding because John can help these students; John shares a photo of a group sitting around a table.
Maria says Maria adopted a black puppy named Shadow from a shelter in the week of 31 July 2023 (last week), and that Shadow brings so much joy and is full of energy.

Maria says Shadow always puts a smile on Maria's face, has been a great addition to Maria's life, and gets along great with Maria's other dog, as shown in a photo of a dog sitting in the grass with a leash.
Maria says Shadow is learning commands and house training, and is an amazing learner who is so much fun to work with and watch grow, and Maria shares a photo of a man standing next to a dog.

John says John's mentoring students have improved in confidence and skills, and that one student, in the week of 31 July 2023 (last week), was excited to show John their essay, which was a proud moment for John.
John says John will look into shelters near John as of 13 August 2023, because it would be great to have a new pup in the house, and asks Maria whether Shadow and Maria's other dog get along.
Maria says Maria did not have pets growing up, but having a furry pal definitely brightens Maria's days, and that pets are great at making people feel loved.
John says animals bring peace and understanding and can always be counted on, which is priceless, and Maria agrees that animals are always there for us.
John says John's family includes John's wife (the missus) and the kids, and that the family has always had John's back even when times are hard, which John calls the best thing ever.

John says John's family loves being outdoors, going for hikes, hanging out at the park and having picnics, and also enjoys playing board games and having movie nights at home, as shown in a photo of two children at a board game.
Maria says spending time with family is so important, and that the family activities John described sound like a blast, as of 13 August 2023.
John tells Maria on 16 August 2023 that John is now part of the fire-fighting brigade and is super excited to be involved and help out John's community.
John says John was impressed by the brigade's dedication and how well its members worked together, and that just being around them was inspiring.

John says the brigade took only two hours to finish a donation drive, and that the group worked hard but did something good, which was really satisfying; John shares a photo of a cardboard box with a sign on it.
John says the brigade raised a ton of donations, including canned food, toiletries and clothes, to help out the local fire station, and that it feels great to be part of it.
John says the donations even helped the fire station get a brand new fire truck, and John shares a photo of the fire truck parked in a garage with other vehicles.
Maria says everyone donated for the fire truck and it looks awesome, and Maria says it is wonderful to see everyone coming together for the local fire station's cause.
John says finding John's passion through the fire brigade has made a big impact and given John a sense of purpose, and that John feels this is John's true calling.

Maria says that last Friday, 11 August 2023, Maria spent time at the shelter volunteering at the front desk, and seeing the smiles on residents' faces when they got food or a bed made Maria feel good.

Maria says people have the power to make a difference in people's lives, and John replies that a little kindness can have such a big impact on someone's life, and that John and Maria should keep making a difference.
John says John and Maria will keep each other and everyone else motivated to make a difference, and that together their impact will surely last, as of 16 August 2023.
